scope: E learner-content organization over accepted canonical Block/KP Core; no medical-Core duplication, no Projection/UI decisions
role: Realize the accepted canonical medical model through continuous Chat/content teaching, complete applicable answers, same-model compression and ordinary review; canonical Block Markdown remains the sole medical Core owner.
hard_rules: Do not duplicate or rewrite canonical medical Core inside this Content owner.

Original Lecture and visuals remain the evidence source for exact wording, decisive visual relations and explicitly Source-bound learning. Their local requirements and HOLD boundaries remain; they do not require a second continuous course or block ordinary Chat/content learning of accepted material.
Logic Group count never determines Source-contact count.
Canonical KP Core supports continuous teaching, full applicable exact answers, checking, repair and reference. KP storage boundaries do not impose serial lessons or mandatory rereading.
Visual gaps/partial visual support remain fail-closed; prose cannot certify unseen visual relations.
S2 exact official-question membership remains UNTESTED and cannot be inferred from Content.

content_layers.ORIENTATION: accepted System/Block model + current medical question + natural title〔complete canonical Prompt〕 nodes + explicit scope/owner boundaries
content_layers.SOURCE_CONTACT: For chosen or locally required Source study, use accepted whole-Block/natural-Source-unit/integration mappings; original visual and exact-wording claims retain their local Source requirements.
content_layers.RETRIEVAL: Optional self-test of the same accepted model; ordinary teaching/review keeps full applicable answers available and imposes no fixed KP/LG quiz cadence.
content_layers.CORE_CHECK: Canonical KP Core supplies the same continuous model and full applicable Memory/Precision answers for teaching, ordinary review, checking and repair; medical truth remains in Block Markdown.
content_layers.BOUNDARY: Source gaps, visual debt, version-sensitive staging/treatment and external-owner boundaries remain explicit
content_layers.COMPRESSION: Block Recall + 3 non-gating PSRs + final System reconstruction compress already-built models These are optional views of the same accepted model, available for ordinary review without requiring a serial closure ladder; formal full-coverage claims still need real coverage.

before_source: If Source study is chosen, orient to the accepted current model and local Source requirements
know the local Source scope boundary / visual debt / owner boundary
Full accepted Core and applicable exact answers may be read continuously in Chat/content
after_source: Continue the same accepted model using the applicable canonical Core and full exact answers
Use optional retrieval when the learner asks for self-test; do not force a stop after each KP/LG
Preserve cognition-specific medical closure criteria and unresolved Source/visual boundaries without claiming unearned completion
Continue ordinary teaching/review, or the chosen accepted Source lane, according to the current learning need
after_block: Block Recall rebuilds the governing reproductive/breast problem rather than reciting KP labels; use this as optional same-model compression, not a compulsory stop
